ctbids-48673-5673899.description:
A handsome collection of vintage Mexican sterling silver jewelry featuring bold links, artisan repouss work, and stamped hallmarks:
 * Mexican Sterling Heavy Shackle / Stirrup-Link Bracelet:
   * Features articulated U-shaped / stirrup links connected with rounded bar pins and a push-in box clasp with safety catch.
   * Fitted with an oval hang-tag stamped with Mexican eagle / maker hallmarks.
   * Measures approximately 8" in total length.
   * Weight: 1.681 oz (approx. 47.6 g).
 * Vintage Mexican Sterling Repouss Clip-On Earrings:
   * Shield / cartouche design with sculpted floral repouss scrollwork bordering smooth central domes.
   * Fitted with secure comfort clip backs.
   * Stamped on reverse: TT-09 925 MEXICO.
   * Combined weight: 0.716 oz (approx. 20.3 g).
 * Sterling Silver Oval Cable-Link Toggle Necklace with Repouss Pendant:
   * Classic heavy open oval-link chain featuring a secure front toggle and ring closure.
   * Suspends a matching repouss scroll medallion/pendant stamped with maker's mark and STERLING .925 on the reverse.
   * Chain length extends over 17" (refer to scale photo for exact layout).
Condition:
Good pre-owned vintage condition throughout. All pieces show warm natural silver patina, light surface wear, and faint tarnishing in crevices consistent with age and gentle wear. Clasps, clips, and toggle closures are fully intact and functional. Please review all photos for dimensions, scale, and individual hallmark impressions.
